title: Accounts Administration Assistant
description:
12-Month Fixed-Term Contract

A fantastic opportunity has arisen to join the finance shared services team of a highly successful global organisation operating within a fast-paced, technology-led environment.

This 12-month fixed-term position has been created to support the continued growth of the European Shared Service Centre and offers the chance to become part of a collaborative finance team supporting multiple international business entities.

The Role

As a Travel & Expense (T&E) Administrator, you will be responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely audit of employee travel and expense claims, providing support with payment activities, and delivering excellent customer service to stakeholders across the business.

Working within a dedicated team, you will help maintain compliance with company policies, resolve employee queries and contribute to the smooth operation of the wider finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Auditing travel and expense submissions in line with company policies and internal controls
- Reviewing and resolving employee and stakeholder queries relating to expenses and financial transactions
- Supporting regular payment runs across multiple entities
- Assisting with month-end and year-end finance processes
- Supporting the preparation of financial reports and documentation
- Investigating and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner
- Maintaining employee data in accordance with data protection requirements
- Working closely with colleagues and other departments to support efficient financial operations
- Contributing to process improvements, training and knowledge-sharing activities
- Supporting wider shared service centre activities as required
- Occasional travel to support finance projects and system implementations

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will ideally possess:
- Previous experience within a transactional finance environment
- Experience using a Travel & Expense platform such as Concur, Chrome River or SAP
- ERP system experience, with SAP highly desirable
- Strong Microsoft Excel and Office skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities
- A proactive approach with strong problem-solving skills
- The ability to work independently and collaboratively
- A positive, customer-focused mindset

Qualifications
- Prior experience in finance administration, accounts payable or transactional finance preferred
- AAT studies or qualification would be advantageous but are not essential

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Annual bonus opportunity
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
- Exposure to a global finance function within a growing international organisation
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunity to contribute to ongoing finance transformation projects

Location

This is a hybrid position based in South Wales. Following an initial training period of approximately 12 weeks, the role will operate on a 3 days office / 2 days home working basis.

title: Warranty Administrator
company: Perfect Placement Uk Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are currently recruiting on behalf of our client for a highly skilled Warranty Administrator to join their reputable multi-franchise dealership in Newport. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the warranty process across three franchises, supporting a team of five Service Advisors. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced automotive professional seeking a long-term career with a well-established dealership group operating throughout South West England and South Wales.

Benefits for the successful Warranty Administrator:
- Salary up to £30,000 per annum, dependent on experience
- Performance-based bonus scheme
- 22 days' annual holiday plus 8 bank holidays
- Discounted car purchase programme for you and your family
- Cycle to work scheme
- Healthcare provisions and hospitality/event perks
- Excellent career progression opportunities within a large, reputable dealership group
- Monday to Friday working hours, 8:30am to 5:00pm, with a 30-minute unpaid lunch break

Duties of the Warranty Administrator:
- Preparing and submitting warranty claims to manufacturers for payment
- Checking weekly statements, querying overdue claims, and resolving discrepancies
- Ensuring warranty documentation aligns with manufacturer guidelines
- Preparing accurate invoices and warranty claims, managing open times and job card write-ups
- Completing repair order documentation accurately and comprehensively
- Ensuring all policy claims are processed promptly and reimbursements are correct
- Maintaining control over returned displaced material
- Reconciling warranty credits and resolving discrepancies efficiently
- Supporting the team with administrative tasks related to vehicle warranty claims

Requirements of the Warranty Administrator:
- Previous experience in automotive warranty administration or a similar administrative role within the motor trade
- Knowledge of warranty procedures and manufacturer policies
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage conflicting priorities
- Excellent interpersonal skills for developing relationships with colleagues and customers
- Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
- Valid UK driving licence with minimal points
- Ideally based in the Treforest region or within a reasonable commuting distance of Newport

This is an exceptional opportunity to join a reputable dealership within a thriving automotive group. If you meet the criteria and are eager to further your career as a Warranty Administrator, we encourage you to apply.

Contact Harry Thaxton-Woodcock, Automotive Recruitment Specialist at Perfect Placement covering Newport and Wales, today to discover more about this fantastic Warranty Administrator opportunity.

At Perfect Placement we specialise in Jobs within the Automotive Field, we can help you with your Career search for Motor Trade Jobs as we have over 1,700 live Automotive Vacancies across the whole of the UK ranging from Vehicle Technician Jobs to Service Manager Jobs.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Newport

Salary: £27,810 per annum

Hours: 40 hours per week

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Working Arrangement: Fully office-based

The Opportunity

Môrwell Talent Solutions is working with an established organisation to recruit an organised, efficient and proactive Accounts Assistant to join their finance team.

This is a varied, hands-on role combining day-to-day accounts responsibilities with general administrative duties. We are looking for someone who takes pride in keeping things organised, works methodically and accurately, and is confident taking ownership of their workload.

The successful candidate will enjoy variety, be comfortable managing competing priorities and be happy getting involved wherever needed to support the smooth running of the department. Strong communication skills are essential, particularly the confidence to pick up the phone, speak with colleagues, suppliers and customers, and proactively follow up on outstanding queries.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts experience who enjoys working in a busy team and is looking for a varied role where they can contribute to the wider business.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts & Finance
- Process supplier invoices and assist with purchase ledger administration, payments and supplier account reconciliations.
- Support sales ledger activities, including raising invoices, monitoring outstanding balances and chasing overdue payments.
- Complete bank reconciliations and reconcile payments received through various channels.
- Assist with daily income reconciliations, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date.
- Investigate discrepancies, resolve queries and liaise with relevant departments, suppliers and customers.
- Support month-end activities, financial reporting and other accounts duties as required.

Administration & Communication
- Provide general administrative support to the finance department and wider business.
- Maintain accurate records, spreadsheets, filing systems and financial documentation.
- Respond to telephone calls and emails from colleagues, suppliers and customers in a professional and timely manner.
- Confidently pick up the phone to chase information, resolve queries and follow up on outstanding issues.
- Liaise with other departments to ensure information is communicated effectively and tasks are completed promptly.
- Manage competing priorities, use initiative and ensure actions are followed through to completion.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, methodical and proactive, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to manage their workload efficiently.

You will be a confident communicator who is comfortable speaking to people at all levels, happy to undertake both accounts and administrative duties, and willing to take ownership rather than waiting to be told what needs doing.

Essential skills and experience:
- Previous experience in an accounts or finance environment.
- An understanding of purchase ledger and sales ledger processes.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- Strong organisational, numerical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including confidence using the telephone.
- A professional approach to accuracy, confidentiality and teamwork.
- The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and use initiative.

Experience within a hotel, hospitality or similar multi-department environment would be advantageous, as would familiarity with accounting software or property management systems.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £27,810 per annum.
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Statutory pension scheme.
- Life assurance scheme.
- The opportunity to join an established finance team in a varied role combining accounts, administration and communication.

Interested?

If you are an organised, efficient and proactive individual who enjoys a varied role, takes pride in getting things done and is confident picking up the phone, we would love to hear from you.

Please contact Môrwell Talent Solutions for further information or to discuss the opportunity in confidence.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Temporary Bookkeeper

Location: Newport

Pay Rate: £15.80-£16.15 per hour + holiday pay

Hours: Full-time (37.5 hours per week) or part-time (32 hours per week)

Contract: Temporary, with the potential to become permanent

Start Date: Immediate

The Opportunity

Môrwell Talent Solutions is currently recruiting for a Temporary Bookkeeper to join a business based in Newport, providing cover for a period of on-going sickness. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional to join the business at short notice and support the day-to-day running of the finance function.

Reporting directly to the Operations Manager, you will be responsible for a varied range of bookkeeping and finance administration duties, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the department. The role would ideally suit an AAT-qualified or QBE finance professional. There may also be the potential for the position to become permanent for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities will include -
- Managing the purchase ledger, including processing supplier invoices and maintaining accurate records.
- Managing the sales ledger, ensuring invoices are raised and accounts are kept up to date.
- Carrying out credit control duties, including monitoring outstanding payments and following up on overdue accounts.
- Performing regular bank and account reconciliations.
- Maintaining accurate financial records using Xero.
- Providing general finance administration support to the Operations Manager and wider business.
- Assisting with day-to-day bookkeeping tasks and ensuring financial information is accurate and up to date.

About You
- Previous experience in a bookkeeping or finance role is essential.
- Relevant experience using Xero is essential.
- Ideally AAT-qualified or Qualified by Experience.
- A good understanding of purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and reconciliations.
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage a varied workload.
- A reliable, proactive approach and the ability to work independently when required.
- Available to start immediately or at very short notice.

Working Arrangements

The role will initially be fully office-based in Newport, with the possibility of some hybrid working further down the line, depending on business needs.

The client is happy to consider candidates seeking either 37.5 hours per week or 32 hours per week, offering some flexibility around working hours.

What's on Offer?
- £15.80-£16.15 per hour, plus holiday pay.
- Immediate start on offer.
- A varied bookkeeping role within an established business.
- Potential for the position to become permanent.
- Consideration for both full-time and part-time working arrangements.

Interested?

If you have relevant bookkeeping experience, are confident using Xero and are available to start at short notice, we'd love to hear from you. Please contact Môrwell Talent Solutions to find out more or apply for the role.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Abergavenny
Salary: £28,000 per annum
Working Pattern: Full-time, hybrid
Sector: Financial Services

Robert Half are partnering with a growing financial services organisation based in Abergavenny to recruit an Accounts Assistant. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional looking to join a stable and supportive business where they can further develop their accounting skills within a busy finance team.

The Role

Reporting into the Finance Manager, the Accounts Assistant will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the business. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing transactions, and assisting with month-end activities.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase and sales ledger invoices
- Managing supplier payments and reconciliations
- Bank reconciliations and cash posting
- Assisting with credit control activities where required
- Processing employee expenses
- Supporting month-end reporting and account reconciliations
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation
- Assisting with ad hoc finance and administrative duties

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Accounts Payable or similar finance role
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- AAT studies or qualifications would be advantageous but are not essential

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000 per annum
- Opportunity to join a well-established financial services business
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Exposure to a broad range of finance responsibilities
- Long-term development opportunities

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply or contact Robert Half for a confidential discussion regarding the opportunity.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training.
